extra.reason: Decided without the spike: build our own AST from scratch matching TypeScript's shape. oxc_ast is deliberately ESTree-flavored (Identifier split into BindingIdentifier/IdentifierReference/IdentifierName per their ARCHITECTURE.md), and tsgo's 60k-LOC checker, 39k-LOC language service and all 49,354 baselines are written against TS's AST shape. Take oxc as inspiration, not dependency. See PLAN.md section 8.

Settled by ADR-0013 and crates/tsr-checker-spike. Three complete implementations over the same vertical slice (memoisation, mutual recursion, circularity, interning), verified to agree. Recommendation: &mut self returning TypeId — 7-23% faster than both interior-mutability styles on realistic shapes AND the only one with no runtime borrow hazard. Benchmark and hazard demonstrations are in the crate.

Landed. tsr-compiler::loader (fileloader.go + filesparser.go: root tasks, DFS, per-task trace buffering, collect_files replay) and tsr_parser::collect_external_module_references (references.go). New file_loader conformance suite: 76/76, 100.00%, judging the '======== Resolving ... ========' headers, their order, AND the resolution mode -- which discharges ADR-0018's stated circularity (module_resolution reads the mode out of the baseline; file_loader supplies nothing).

No rate moved, by construction: module_resolution replays requests taken from the baseline, so no loader can change it. Denominators: file_loader 76 = module_resolution 75 + 3 empty-trace cases (now assertions) - 2 libReplacement cases (tsr-9or.5).

100% on the first run, so it was checked rather than believed: 4 mutations to the code under test gave 39/76, 71/76, 66/76, 74/76.

Deliberately not done, each named in ADR-0019 with a falsifier: lib files (resolve nothing; libReplacement is tsr-9or.5), importHelpers/tslib (zero baselines), project references, per-casing tasks and lowest-depth reprocessing, moduleDetection (assumed auto), import.meta as a module indicator (tsr-9or.4).
